patient_name.label: What is your loved one's name?
patient_name.hint: This name is stored only on your device for privacy.

disease_stage.label: What stage of dementia?
disease_stage.early_description: Mild memory lapses, difficulty finding words, some confusion with complex tasks. Can still manage most daily activities independently.
disease_stage.middle_description: Increasing confusion, difficulty recognizing people, behavioral changes, needs help with daily activities like dressing and bathing.
disease_stage.late_description: Severe memory loss, limited communication, needs full-time assistance with all daily activities, may not recognize family members.

setup.heading: Let's set up your care profile
setup.subtitle: We'll ask a few questions about your loved one so we can give you the most helpful guidance during difficult moments.
setup.name_label: What is your loved one's first name?
setup.name_privacy: This name stays on your device only and is never stored on our servers. We use it to personalize your guidance so it feels more natural.
setup.stage_heading: What stage best describes your loved one?
setup.stage_subtitle: This helps us tailor our guidance. You can always change this later.
setup.behavioral_stage_heading: Which best describes your loved one RIGHT NOW?

behavioral.title: What behavioral patterns have you noticed?
behavioral.description: Select all that apply. This helps us give you more relevant guidance.

calming.title: What calming strategies work for your loved one?
calming.description: Select what has worked before, even occasionally. We'll suggest these during tough moments.

safety.title: Any safety concerns we should know about?
safety.description: Select all that apply so we can include relevant safety reminders in our guidance.

invite.heading: Enter your access code
invite.subtitle: CalmGuide is currently in private testing. Enter the invite code you were given to continue.
invite.hint: Don't have one? Ask whoever invited you to CalmGuide for a code.

success.save_code_message: Save this access code. You will need it to log back in on any device.
success.screenshot_hint: Screenshot this or write it down somewhere safe.

errors.no_access_code: No access code found. Please create a new profile.
errors.invalid_invite_code: That invite code isn't valid. Double check it and try again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

view.title: Care Profile
view.name_hint: Name stored on your device only
view.access_code_hint: Save this code to access your profile from another device

sign_out.title: Sign Out
sign_out.message: This will remove your access code and your loved one's name from this device. Your care profile stays saved — you can sign back in anytime with your access code.

avatar.title: Portrait
avatar.description: Pick the picture that stands in for this person. It stays on this device.

voice.label: Voice
voice.auto_speak_replies_hint: Moment Coach and Check-In responses will be read aloud as soon as they arrive, without needing to tap the speaker icon.
